text:
### HubSpot Sales Hub®

Sales Hub is one of six ‘Hubs’ that HubSpot offers. The others are for marketing, service, content, data, and revenue.

HubSpot now prices Sales Hub by seat, with no separate platform base fee, and annual billing costs less than monthly. HubSpot also offers a cost-effective Small Business Bundle for startups and small businesses. This bundle includes the Starter edition of each HubSpot product. Starter lists at $20 per seat per month, but for a limited time, new customers can get it for $7 per seat billed annually or $10 per seat billed monthly.

| Sales Hub Enterprise | $150 (plus a one-time $3,500 onboarding fee) |
| Sales Hub Professional | $90 billed annually, $100 billed monthly (plus a one-time $1,500 onboarding fee) |
| Sales Hub Starter | $20 (limited-time new-customer rate from $7) |

### Salesforce

Salesforce provides a straightforward per-user pricing scheme across all its editions. The following is the pricing for Sales Cloud. Starter Suite can be billed monthly or annually; Pro Suite and higher editions are billed annually. Salesforce raised its Enterprise and Unlimited prices by about 6% in 2025, and its top-tier Agentforce 1 Sales edition includes its Agentforce AI agents.

Copilot is included starting with Sales Enterprise. SugarCRM rebranded as SugarAI in April 2026. Its sales product, Sugar Sell, comes in three published packages, all billed annually. title: Choosing a CRM for a Twenty-Person Company - Global Brands Drive
text:
Eight CRMs priced at eight seats from their own published pages — and why the tier you pick moves the bill more than the brand does.

By Global Brands Drive Editorial Team September 6, 2026 15 min read

Eight vendors priced at eight seats, from their own published pages.

 In this article 

At eight CRM seats and annual billing, the tier a twenty-person company actually needs costs between US$2,688 and US$10,140 in year one across eight vendors whose prices are published. That is a 3.8× spread for what is broadly the same job. But the vendor is not the decision that moves the bill most. Moving up one tier — usually because you want workflow automation — costs 1.69× more per seat at one vendor and 12.86× more at another. Pick the tier before you pick the brand.

Every figure below is a list price read from the vendor’s own public pricing page on 5 September 2026, at annual billing, and re-read the same day. Two vendors could not be priced at all; they are named, and why, further down.

...

## The scenario, stated before the numbers

“A CRM for a twenty-person company” is not a price until you say how many people will hold a licence. Almost all of this market is priced per seat, so seat count is an input, not a detail.

The scenario used throughout is eight seats — six people selling, two managing or running operations, inside a company of twenty. Everything is tested again at four and sixteen seats further down, because that assumption does more work than any other in the model.

Two tiers are priced for each vendor: the cheapest paid plan that a team can actually share, and the tier above it. The step between them is where the interesting numbers are, because that step is what a company buys when it stops wanting a shared contact list and starts wanting the software to do something on its own.

## What eight seats cost at eight vendors

Year one at eight seats, mid tier

List prices at annual billing, read 5 September 2026

 

Source: Each vendor’s own public pricing page, collected by Global Brands Drive on 5 September 2026 and listed in full at the end. Annual billing throughout. Chart by Global Brands Drive.

The list below is the full price table the chart is drawn from. “Entry” is the cheapest paid plan a team can share; “Mid” is the next tier up.

| Vendor | Entry plan | Per seat/mo | Mid plan | Per seat/mo | One-time fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HubSpot Sales Hub | Starter | US$7 | Professional | US$90 | US$1,500 |
| Salesforce | Starter Suite | US$25 | Pro Suite | US$100 | — |
| Pipedrive | Lite | US$14 | Premium | US$59 | — |
| Freshsales | Growth | US$9 | Pro | US$39 | — |
| Close | Essentials | US$35 | Growth | US$99 | — |
| Attio | Plus (max 10 seats) | US$35 | Pro | US$79 | — |
| monday CRM | Basic (min 3 seats) | US$12 | Pro | US$28 | — |
| Insightly | Plus | US$29 | Professional | US$49 | — |

All figures are per seat per month at annual billing, as printed on each vendor’s own pricing page on 5 September 2026. HubSpot’s page states that the cost shown “does not include the required, one-time Professional Onboarding for a fee of $1,500.” Prices change; check before you budget.

At the entry tier the same eight seats cost between US$672 and US$3,360 a year. At the mid tier, between US$2,688 and US$10,140. Both ranges are wide, and neither tells you which product fits — that is the point of the next section rather than a criticism of any price on the list.

...

| Configuration | Lowest | Highest | Multiple |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4 seats, mid tier | US$1,344 | US$5,820 | 4.33× |
| 8 seats, mid tier | US$2,688 | US$10,140 | 3.77× |
| 16 seats, mid tier | US$5,376 | US$19,200 | 3.57× |
| One vendor, 4 → 16 seats | US$1,872 | US$7,488 | 4.00× |

The final row holds the vendor fixed (Freshsales Pro) and varies only the seat count. Changing vendor at a fixed eight seats moves the bill 3.77×; changing seat count at a fixed vendor moves it 4.00×. Calculated by Global Brands Drive from published list prices.

...

| Plan | Annual | Monthly | Monthly is higher by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Salesforce Starter Suite | US$25/seat/mo | US$25/seat/mo | 0.0% |
| Close Growth | US$99/seat/mo | US$109/seat/mo | 10.1% |
| HubSpot Sales Hub Professional | US$90/seat/mo | US$100/seat/mo | 11.1% |
| Attio Pro | US$79/seat/mo | US$99/seat/mo | 25.3% |
| Close Essentials | US$35/seat/mo | US$49/seat/mo | 40.0% |
| monday CRM Pro | US$28/seat/mo | US$41/seat/mo | 46.4% |
| HubSpot Sales Hub Starter | US$7/seat/mo | US$20/seat/mo | 185.7% |

...

1. Fix the seat count first, in writing Decide who actually needs a licence, and add the growth you expect within twelve months. Every price on this page is per seat, so this number sets the bill more than the logo on the invoice does.
2. Decide which tier you need before you shortlist Write down the one capability that would make you leave the entry tier — usually automation of a step someone currently does by hand. If you cannot name it, you are buying the entry tier.
3. Price both tiers at every vendor on the shortlist The ranking at the entry tier is not the ranking at the tier above it. On this data the step varies by 7.6× between vendors, so a shortlist built at one tier can be wrong at the other.
4. Add the one-time fees and the seat rules before you compare A required onboarding charge, a minimum seat count and a maximum seat count are all published, and all change the answer.

...

Year one at eight seats, mid tier

Every cell carries its unit. Prices read 5 September 2026.

| Vendor and plan | Working | Year one |
| --- | --- | --- |
| monday CRM Pro | US$28/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$2,688 |
| Freshsales Pro | US$39/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$3,744 |
| Insightly Professional | US$49/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$4,704 |
| Pipedrive Premium | US$59/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$5,664 |
| Attio Pro | US$79/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$7,584 |
| Close Growth | US$99/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$9,504 |
| Salesforce Pro Suite | US$100/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 | US$9,600 |
| HubSpot Sales Hub Professional | US$90/seat/mo × 8 seats × 12 + US$1,500 onboarding | US$10,140 |
| Range | US$10,140 ÷ US$2,688 | 3.77× |

The tier-step multiple is the mid-tier per-seat price divided by the entry-tier per-seat price for the same vendor: for example US$90 ÷ US$7 = 12.86 for HubSpot Sales Hub, and US$49 ÷ US$29 = 1.69 for Insightly. The 7.6× headline is 12.86 ÷ 1.69. The onboarding shares are US$1,500 divided by the year-one total at each seat count.

title: Best CRM for Small Teams: Features, Limits and Costs
text:
## Quick answer

For 5 to 25 people, the cheapest hosted CRMs on our read date were Freshsales Growth and Twenty Cloud Pro at $9 per seat a month on annual billing. HubSpot is free for 2 users, then $20 per seat. Attio Plus costs $35 per seat but stops at 10. Twenty and EspoCRM can be self-hosted with no licence fee.

...

Each cost below is the cheapest plan that allows the stated number of seats, on annual billing where the vendor prints an annual price, before tax and add-ons.

...

| CRM | Free tier | 5 seats | 10 seats | 25 seats | Self-host |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HubSpot | Up to 2 users | $100 (Starter) | $200 | $500 | No |
| Attio | Up to 3 seats | $175 (Plus) | $350 | $1,975 (Pro) | No |
| Freshsales | Not confirmed | $45 (Growth) | $90 | $225 | No |
| Twenty | Self-host only | $45 (Cloud Pro) | $90 | $225 | Yes, AGPL |
| EspoCRM | Self-host only | $75 (Cloud Basic) | $150 | $375 | Yes, AGPL |

Monthly cost per team, US dollars.

...

## HubSpot

HubSpot's free CRM allows up to 2 users, 1,000 contacts and 1,000 records for each other standard object. That makes it the obvious starting point for a founder and one colleague. Starter lists at $20 per seat per month. On our read date the page also advertised Starter from $7 per seat for new customers. We use the list price because the offer is not open to everyone and has no stated end date.

The jump to Professional is the one to plan for. The Sales Hub pricing page shows Professional at $90 or $100 per seat per month, depending on billing period, plus a required one-time onboarding fee of $1,500. A 10-person team moving from Starter to Professional goes from $200 to at least $900 a month.

Best for: teams of one or two who want to start free, and teams that will run marketing email from the CRM.

## Attio

Attio prints both billing periods and its caps clearly. Free covers up to 3 seats and 50,000 records. Plus costs $35 per seat annually ($44 monthly) and stops at 10 seats. Pro costs $79 annually ($99 monthly) with no cap. AI features run on monthly credits per seat and per workspace.

The 10-seat cap on Plus shapes the decision. A team that expects to grow past 10 within a contract term should price Pro from the start: $1,975 a month at 25 seats.

Best for: teams of up to 10 that track relationships beyond a sales pipeline, such as investors, partners or candidates.

...

Freshworks lists Freshsales at $9 (Growth), $39 (Pro) and $59 (Enterprise) per user per month, billed annually. The page's monthly figures and the limits of the free plan mentioned in its description were not visible in the text we read, so we have not quoted them. A 21-day trial is offered.

...

## Which one fits your team?

- Two people, starting out: HubSpot free or Attio free.
- Five to ten people, lowest cost: Freshsales Growth or Twenty Cloud Pro, both $9 per seat.
- Up to ten people modelling custom records: Attio Plus, but price Pro if you might reach 11.
- Any size, data on your own server: Twenty or EspoCRM self-hosted.
- Marketing and sales in one system: HubSpot, budgeting for Professional and its onboarding fee if you need its automation.
